notes.title: Tutorial Flow Fix – Stability Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content: This update addresses several issues that caused the game to freeze or become unresponsive during the tutorial. Improvements have been made to the tutorial flow, event triggers, and interaction logic to ensure a smoother and uninterrupted experience for new players.

notes.title: 🛠️ Final Fuel Station Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, a big thank you to everyone who played Fuel Station Simulator during its Early Access phase. Your feedback, suggestions, and support have meant a lot and played a key role in shaping the game.

Today, we're releasing a small update that includes:
[list]
[*]🔧 Fixes for some bugs reported by the community
[*]🎨 Vsual and performance improvements
[*]📦 Preparation for the game’s transition out of Early Access
[/list]

After careful consideration, we've decided to officially mark the game as released. While we didn’t manage to implement all the features we initially envisioned, the game now offers a stable and complete experience in its current form.

There are no plans for major gameplay updates moving forward, but we’ll continue to provide maintenance patches if any technical issues arise.

[h3]🚧 What’s Next?[/h3]
Meanwhile, we're working on a new game, building on everything we’ve learned from Fuel Station. While we’re not ready to share full details just yet, the new title will offer a richer and more dynamic gameplay experience.

Once again, thank you for being part of this journey.
See you soon — with something new. 👋

notes.title: Spontaneous Missions: Help Stranded Drivers in Need!
notes.content:
[h2]Discover a new layer of gameplay with Spontaneous Missions![/h2]
Now, you can respond to emergency calls from drivers who have run out of fuel. It all starts when the phone at your station rings. Pick up, learn the details, and decide if you’re ready to take on the challenge.

Once you accept:

[olist]
[*] A marker will appear on the map, showing the driver’s location.
[*] Load fuel into a Gas Can.
[*] Hop in your car and drive to the destination before the timer runs out.
[*] Refuel the stranded vehicle and claim your generous reward.
[/olist]

Bug Fixes:
We’ve resolved the issue where customers were not visiting the shop. Your station is now back to being a lively hub for buyers and drivers alike.

We’ve also added a small tutorial to introduce this new system, along with a new item, the Gas Can, to make fuel delivery seamless. The public phone box on the map is now your gateway to exciting missions and special rewards!

Earn points, and create unforgettable experiences for drivers in need! 🎉

notes.title: 🛠️ Version 0.1.3 is Live! Major Fixes & Fresh Mechanics!
notes.content:

Hello everyone! We’ve got exciting news for you: Version 0.1.3 - Early Access has just been released, and it’s one of the biggest updates so far. 🎉 In this version, we focused on fixing the issues that bothered you the most while also adding some new features to enhance your experience. Let’s dive into

notes.title: Full Gamepad and Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, station managers! [/h2]
We’re excited to announce that Fuel Station Simulator has received a major update that takes your gameplay experience to the next level. Following community feedback, we’ve implemented full gamepad support. Whether you’re using an Xbox Controller, DualShock, DualSense, or exploring the game world on a Steam Deck, this update delivers an enhanced experience for all players.

[h2]What’s new in this update?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Full gamepad support – Navigate menus, manage your station, and complete tasks with exceptional fluidity, regardless of the controller you’re using.
[*] Steam Deck optimization – The game runs flawlessly on the portable device, featuring a UI adapted to the screen size and intuitive controls.
[*] Dynamic Control Icons:
The game now detects the active input device and automatically updates the on-screen button icons. Whether you're using a keyboard, an Xbox gamepad, or a DualSense gamepad, the experience is now more intuitive and personalized! 🎮✨
[*] Customizable settings – Fine-tune sensitivity and button configurations to match your preferred playstyle.
[/list]

This is just a part of our ongoing plans, and your feedback is invaluable. The update is live now, so grab your controller and enjoy smoother, more immersive gameplay than ever befor

notes.title: Update Patch - Important Fixes! 🛠️
notes.content:
[h3]Hello community,

I’m excited to announce the release of a patch that brings several fixes and improvements based on the feedback from our amazing community. Thank you for helping us improve the gaming experience! And rest assured, the work doesn’t stop here.[/h3]

[h2]🛠️ Important Fixes:[/h2]

[h3]Fixed a core issue where the fuel volume would not decrease and would refill automatically after each refueling. ⛽🔧[/h3]


[h3]Technology Tree Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the tech points on the UI would not refresh after leveling up.
[*] "AutoRefilling" Technology: This feature now works as intended. If you have unlocked this technology and the tank is empty, you can refuel vehicles by automatically purchasing fuel. You will only receive the profit margin for the sale. ⛽🚜
[*]Fixed technologies designed to reduce the fuel purchase price from the refinery. In some cases, the expected discount was not applied. 💸
[/list]

[h3]Inventory Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to have duplicate items of the same type in the inventory.
[*] After this update, any duplicated items in your inventory will be automatically removed. 🎒❌
[/list]

[h3]Other Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where players were sometimes unable to interact with boxes or other objects. 📦
[*] Fixed a visual bug in the store where white spots would appear after cleaning. 🧹✨
[/list]


That seems to be all the important fixes for now.

Thank you for your continued support, and a special thanks to our Discord community for actively participating and reporting the issues. If you'd like to join the group, you can access the link below.

🌐 [url=https://discord.gg/2ZfZ7mmhFf]Click to join[/url]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update – Early Access
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

[h3]We have a new update for our game in Early Access! In this update, we’ve focused on fixing some important issues, including:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Tutorial Fix – The main issue preventing the tutorial from working properly has been resolved.
[*] Delivery Issues – The delivery car no longer disappears after waiting for a while (the anti-blocking system was mistakenly marking it as blocked).
[*] Lighting Issues – Problems with lighting in the game scenes have been fixed.
[*] Cars Not Arriving at Gas Station – Deliveries will now correctly arrive at the designated location.
[/olist]

Thank you for your continued feedback and patience!

notes.title: #devlog - Workers Are Here!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 Workers Are Here![/h2]
I’m excited to announce that I’ve just finished working on the worker system! As you progress through the game, you’ll be able to hire workers to help automate some processes. For now, you’ll be able to hire:

[h3]🧑‍💼 Cashier[/h3] – Their role will be to manage the store, taking care of customers and handling transactions.
[h3]⛽ Pump Worker[/h3] – The main task of this worker will be to fuel the vehicles that arrive at your station. You won’t have to worry about cars waiting for fuel anymore!


[h2]🔮 Future Plans for this System (Roadmap)[/h2]
I’m planning to add two more types of workers in the future:
[olist]
[*] Warehouse Worker – Unloads delivery trucks and organizes goods in the storage area.
[*] Janitor – Keeps the station clean and restocks items on the shelves.
[/olist]

I’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions on this! 💬

[h2]Summary:[/h2]
This update will bring a whole new dynamic to running your station. You’ll be able to focus more on overall strategy and business expansion, while your staff takes care of daily tasks. Stay tuned for more details on the release, and start planning how to best use your new workforce! 🎯

notes.title: Devlog #7 - Tech Tree
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]

Hello, We are excited to present Devlog #7, where we will delve into two essential new features that will add depth and complexity to our game: the Level System and the Tech Tree. These mechanics will not only influence how you interact with the game but will also open up unique strategic opportunities. Let’s explore them together!

[h2]Level System[/h2]

The level system shows your experience level with each fueled car, each product sold, and even by maintaining cleanliness. For every activity, you’ll receive experience points that contribute to leveling up. At release, the maximum level will be 50. Each new level unlocks new possibilities and also grants you Tech Points, which can be used in the Tech Tree.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ynEZRsV.gif[/img]

[h2]Tech Tree[/h2]

Many of you might be familiar with the concept of a "skill tree" or other similar implementations. The purpose of this tactic is the same: to give players the ability to choose their own development path. Tech Points will not be enough to unlock all technologies, so you will need to follow a clear strategy to maximize your profit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BjsqJ09.gif[/img]

[h2]Your Opinion Matters![/h2]

We’d love to hear your thoughts on the level system and the Tech Tree! How do you feel about these new mechanics ?

notes.title: Devlog #6 - Day/Night Cycle
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Devlog #6![/h1]
In this devlog, we discuss the new improvements brought to the game, including the day/night cycle, dynamic clouds, and volumetric lighting.

[h2]Introducing the Day/Night Cycle[/h2]
We’ve added a complete day and night cycle to bring more realism to Fuel Station Simulator. From sunrise to sunset, you’ll notice gradual changes in light and shadows, enhancing the gameplay experience.

[h2]Check out the video below to see all the new features in action![/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GaoJIlF.gif[/img]

[h2]Dynamic Clouds for Variety[/h2]
Dynamic clouds add beautiful variety to the sky, changing according to weather and time of day. This brings a new visual dimension to the game while maintaining optimal performance.

[h2]Lighting Effects with Volumetric Lighting[/h2]
We’ve implemented a volumetric lighting system to make the lighting effects even more spectacular. This system is optimized to ensure good performance while enhancing the game atmosphere.

We hope you enjoy the new look of Fuel Station Simulator. Thank you for your continued support, and don’t forget to follow us for the latest updates and information on the game’s development!

notes.title: New Location: Refinery
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Gas Station Simulator Players and Enthusiasts,[/h2]

We are excited to introduce the latest addition to your gameplay experience - The Refinery. This new location allows you to purchase fuel in large quantities to supply your gas station and ensure you're always ready for the steady stream of customers.

[h2]What’s New with The Refinery?[/h2]

[h3]Bulk Purchasing:[/h3] 
You cannot rely on deliveries at the early stages of development. Instead, you can visit the Refinery to negotiate advantageous contracts and procure fuel at competitive prices.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/30XdUBl.png[/img]

[h3]Logistics Management: 🚛[/h3]

Load the fuel into barrels and transport them back to your gas station using your trailer or pickup. Each barrel has a capacity of 100 liters. This new gameplay mechanic adds a layer of complexity and realism to management. 🎮

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YROKMZz.gif[/img]

[h2]Income comes with risks:[/h2]

You are solely responsible for delivery and any issues that arise along the way. If due to negligence or rule violations you cause an accident, the cargo may suffer and may not always reach its destination.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jx96Znp.gif[/img]

PS: Drive carefully to safely deliver the gasoline to its destination.

[h2]Refueling the tank:[/h2]

This is the final step of the delivery; now that the fuel is in the tank, all that remains is to sell it and make a profit.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y6nH1A4.gif[/img]

This new feature is designed to enhance and diversify how you manage your business in Gas Station Simulator. We hope you find this update both useful and fun, and we look forward to hearing your feedback.

Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions with us. 

[url=https://discord.gg/MgBych9bev][img]https://i.imgur.com/glS1UeM.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: #DevLog 4 - Delivery System
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! 
[h2]Let's delve into the delivery system and what it entails.[/h2][/h1]

This encompasses everything related to orders, delivery, and management. We'll start with orders you can place on the website of the main store
[h2]Global Store[/h2]

This is an online store where you can buy everything you need in large quantities and at a discounted price
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZiSLDmZ.png[/img]

[h2]Warehouse[/h2]

You don't have a virtual inventory to store everything, which is why the Warehouse plays a crucial role. All products are physical items, so you must take care of their storage and maintain order in the warehouse, as it can quickly turn into a cluttered mess. Procure various warehouse equipment to facilitate storage and preservation. 📦🧹

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QlD1bIg.png[/img]

notes.title: #DevLog 2 - Recycling Center
notes.content:
Hey everyone! It's been a bit since our last DevLog, and we're thrilled to bring you #DevLog2. Drumroll, please! 🥁 We've decided to spice things up with an exciting addition - the "Recycling Station."

[h3] 🚗 New Interactive Feature: Control Your Ride![/h3]
To make your gameplay even more engaging, you can now take the wheel and control a car. This allows for quicker navigation between the new locations we're planning to introduce soon.

[h3]🌍 Recycling Station: More Than Trash Talk! [/h3]
Got stuff you're thinking of tossing? Hold up! Load it into your pick-up, haul it to the Recycling Station, and score a bonus. Extra cash for you, and a cleaner environment. Oh, and you'll rack up "Environment Guardian" points! 🌿💰

[h3]💬 Your Feedback Matters: Join the Discussion! [/h3]
We want to hear from you! Share your thoughts on this new feature and suggest ideas for upcoming locations. Head to the "Discussions" section or hop on our Discord channel. Your input could shape not only future DevLogs but also the game itself.
[url=https://discord.gg/MgBych9bev]Join Discord[/url]

[h3]🌐 Connect with Us:  [/h3]
Join the conversation and become a part of our community. Your ideas matter, and we can't wait to see what you come up with!
